labels.title: Live Simulation Panel
labels.description: Change any input and the entire dashboard re-computes instantly from local JSON. No backend, no network calls.
labels.derivedHint: Computed from temperature, humidity, wind and time of day by the local engine.

aqi.label: Good
aqi.advice: Air quality is satisfactory. Unrestricted outdoor activity.

aqi.label: Moderate
aqi.advice: Acceptable for most people. Highly sensitive individuals should pace effort.

aqi.label: Unhealthy for Sensitive
aqi.advice: Asthma, COPD and cardiac patients should reduce prolonged exertion.

aqi.label: Unhealthy
aqi.advice: Everyone may feel effects. Move intense activity indoors.

aqi.label: Very Unhealthy
aqi.advice: Health alert. Avoid outdoor exertion entirely.

aqi.label: Hazardous
aqi.advice: Emergency conditions. Stay indoors with closed windows.

uv.label: Low
uv.advice: No protection needed for short exposure.

uv.label: Moderate
uv.advice: Use SPF 30 and seek shade around midday.

uv.label: High
uv.advice: SPF 50, hat and sunglasses. Limit midday exposure.

uv.label: Extreme
uv.advice: Unprotected skin burns in under 15 minutes. Stay indoors.

humidity.label: Dry
humidity.advice: Increase water intake; static and dust irritation increase.

humidity.label: Comfortable
humidity.advice: Evaporative cooling works well. Ideal for outdoor activity.

humidity.label: Humid
humidity.advice: Sweat evaporation drops. Hydrate ahead of activity.

humidity.label: Very Humid
humidity.advice: Heat stress compounds quickly. Reduce intensity and duration.

wind.label: Calm
wind.advice: Ideal for running, spraying and drone survey.

wind.label: Moderate
wind.advice: Spray drift risk rises above 15 km/h. Secure loose items.

wind.label: Fresh
wind.advice: Difficult conditions for spraying and cycling. Watch gusts.

wind.label: Strong Gale
wind.advice: Travel disruption likely. Avoid exposed routes.

visibility.label: Poor
visibility.advice: Visibility under 1 km. Use low beams and fog signals.

visibility.label: Low
visibility.advice: Reduced contrast. Allow extra following distance.

visibility.label: Moderate
visibility.advice: Slight haze. Comfortable for most journeys.

rainProbability.label: Dry
rainProbability.advice: No rain expected. Plan outdoor work freely.

rainProbability.label: Isolated Showers
rainProbability.advice: Carry a light rain layer. Harvest window still open.

rainProbability.label: Showers Likely
rainProbability.advice: Intermittent rain. Complete spraying before noon.

rainProbability.label: Rain Expected
rainProbability.advice: Sustained rain likely. Delay chemical application.

rainProbability.label: Heavy Rain
rainProbability.advice: Continuous heavy rain. Waterlogging risk on low ground.

temperature.label: Freezing
temperature.advice: Frost risk on exposed crops. Start frost protection.

temperature.label: Cold
temperature.advice: Cold stress for sensitive people. Layer clothing.

temperature.label: Mild
temperature.advice: Comfortable temperature band for most activity.

temperature.label: Warm
temperature.advice: Warm and workable. Keep hydration within reach.

temperature.label: Hot
temperature.advice: Heat stress builds. Schedule breaks every 45 minutes.

temperature.label: Extreme Heat
temperature.advice: Heatstroke risk. Stay indoors and hydrate continuously.

score.label: Excellent
score.advice: Ideal conditions for the planned activity.

score.label: Fair
score.advice: Manageable, but pace and duration should be reduced.

score.label: Poor
score.advice: Conditions work against the activity. Reschedule if possible.

riskLevels.label: Safe
riskLevels.description: No meaningful weather hazard detected for this persona.
riskLevels.advice: Conditions are comfortable. Proceed with planned activity.

riskLevels.label: Moderate
riskLevels.description: One or two manageable hazards. Minor adjustment advised.
riskLevels.advice: Adjust timing or intensity, and carry a fallback plan.

riskLevels.label: High
riskLevels.description: Multiple hazards stacking up. Plan changes required.
riskLevels.advice: Change the plan: shorten, reschedule or relocate the activity.

riskLevels.label: Extreme
riskLevels.description: Severe hazard combination. Exposure is unsafe.
riskLevels.advice: Postpone the activity and follow official advisories.
